title: Chicken and Hollandaise Bowl
description: A rich and creamy bowl filled with tender chicken and topped with a tangy Hollandaise sauce.
instructions: 2. Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
3. Place the chicken in the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
4. While the chicken is cooking, warm the Hollandaise sauce in a saucepan over low heat.
5. Once the chicken is done, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing.
6. To assemble the bowl, place a slice of chicken in the bottom of the bowl.
7. Spoon the warmed Hollandaise sauce over the top of the chicken.
